# Player Received Healing

Source: [4813](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/4813); edited 2024-11-26. Evidence: archived documentation.

Not independently verified in the current game. An article edit date is not a behavioral test date.

<a id="wiki-4813-n1"></a>

- Received Healing includes self-healing; Event Player equals Healee, while Healer is source (equal for self-heal). Context includes Event Healing, health-pack flag, ability and incoming direction.
